title: GLRI Act of 2025
latestAction: Referred to the Subcommittee on Water Resources and Environment.
summary:
Great Lakes Restoration Initiative Act of 2025 or the GLRI Act of 2025

This bill reauthorizes through FY2031 the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative, which carries out programs and projects to protect and restore the Great Lakes.
